title: 10 PROMPTS
THAT SOUND
LIKE *YOU*
subtitle: Copy, paste, fill in the blanks. Works in ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.
tagline: From the reel: stop typing 'write me a script'

blocks.heading: The *4-part* formula
blocks.intro: AI writes generic scripts when the prompt is generic. Give it these four things and it writes like you.
steps: Your niche and your size. [I'm a fitness creator with 3K followers.]
One audience with one problem. [Write for busy beginners who keep skipping the gym.]
How the first line should grab them. [Open with a mistake they're making.]
Length and shape. [30 seconds, 3 tips, one line each.]
blocks.note: Same AI. Thirty more seconds of typing. A script that sounds like you.

items.line: I'm a [niche] creator with [follower count]. Write a [length] reel script for [audience] who [problem]. Open with [hook style]. Format: [format].
items.example: I'm a cooking creator with 1K followers. Write a 30-second script for students who think cooking takes too long. Open with a surprising number. 3 recipes, one line each.
items.why: All four parts in one prompt: voice, audience, hook and format.

items.line: Give me 10 hooks for a reel about [topic] for [audience]. Mix these styles: a mistake, a surprising number, a bold opinion, a question. Max 10 words each.
items.example: Give me 10 hooks for a reel about saving money for college students...
items.why: Asking for several styles gives you real options instead of ten versions of one line.

items.line: Here are 3 captions I wrote: [paste captions]. Describe my tone in 5 words. Then rewrite this script in that tone: [script].
items.example: Paste three captions people liked, then the AI draft you want to fix.
items.why: The AI copies your real writing instead of guessing.

items.line: Here are comments from my audience: [paste comments]. Turn them into 10 reel ideas, each with a one-line hook.
items.example: Paste 15 to 20 comments or DMs with real questions.
items.why: Ideas from real questions already have an audience.

items.line: Turn this reel script into a 6-slide carousel, a caption and 3 story polls: [script].
items.example: Use your best-performing script from last month.
items.why: One idea, five posts, no extra filming.

items.line: Write an Instagram caption for this reel: [script]. Start with the hook, keep it under [word count] words, end with a question, no emojis, [number] hashtags.
items.example: ...keep it under 120 words, end with a question, no emojis, 5 hashtags.
items.why: Clear limits stop the AI from writing a wall of filler.

items.line: Cut this script to [seconds] seconds without losing the hook or the payoff: [script].
items.example: Cut this script to 20 seconds without losing the hook or the payoff...
items.why: Shorter reels get rewatched; this keeps the parts that matter.

items.line: I make content about [niche] for [audience]. Give me 4 content pillars and 5 video ideas for each.
items.example: I make content about budget travel for first-time solo travellers...
items.why: Twenty ideas in one answer, all on-brand.

items.line: Give me 10 cover texts for this reel, max 5 words each, that make [audience] curious: [script].
items.why: The cover decides whether people tap on your profile grid.

items.line: This reel got [views] views. Script: [script]. Give me the 3 most likely reasons people scrolled past, then rewrite the first 3 seconds.
items.why: Turns a flop into a better second version instead of a guess.

blocks.heading: Before you hit *send*
items: Did I say who I am and how big my account is?
Did I name one audience with one problem?
Did I tell it how to open (the hook)?
Did I give a length and a format?
Did I read the answer out loud and cut what I would never say?
blocks.closing: AI gives you a draft. Your voice makes it a reel.
